name: second-opinion
description: Get second opinions from external AIs (Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Claude) on code reviews, architecture decisions, and implementation approaches

enable_codex.title: Enable Codex
enable_codex.description: Allow /second-opinion to call the Codex CLI. Turn off for a backend you do not have installed or authenticated.

enable_gemini.description: Allow /second-opinion to call the Gemini CLI. Turn off for a backend you do not have installed or authenticated.

enable_claude.description: Allow /second-opinion to call the Claude CLI. Turn off for a backend you do not have installed or authenticated.
